1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi babwira inanga. Ni indirimbo ya Dawidi yahimbishijwe ubwenge.

2.text: Yayihimbye ubwo ab'i Zifu bagendaga bakabaza Sawuli bati “Ntuzi yuko Dawidi yihishe iwacu?”

3.text: Mana, nkirisha izina ryawe,Uncirishirize urubanza imbaraga zawe.

4.text: Mana, umva gusenga kwanjye,Tegera ugutwi amagambo yo mu kanwa kanjye.

5.text: Kuko abanyamahanga bampagurukiye,N'abanyarugomo bashatse ubugingo bwanjye,Batashyize Imana imbere yabo.Sela.

6.text: Dore Imana ni umutabazi wanjye,Umwami ari mu ruhande rw'abaramira ubugingo bwanjye.

7.text: Azitura inabi abanzi banjye,Ubarimbure ku bw'umurava wawe.

8.text: Nzagutambira igitambo kiva mu rukundo,Uwiteka, kuko izina ryawe ari ryiza nzarishima.

9.text: Kuko Uwiteka yankijije amakuba n'ibyago byanjye byose,Ijisho ryanjye rikabona icyo rishakira abanzi banjye.
